learning: The a3 root/pending question is answered at the convention level: root = context.back() = pending token at position seq_lens, and the multi-step host bookkeeping is token-exact when the overlap splice and accept_lens-incl-bonus hold. New falsifiable narrowing: (i) a stale/mis-spliced draft root is a CORRECTNESS fault, not a draft-quality fault (stale_root diverges at token 1); (ii) skipping the overlap prev_tokens splice makes the root already-cached and diverges at token 4; (iii) engine seq_lens drift is also a correctness fault because it sets the verify mask prefix width (ties t5/t6 to F1). The first-divergence position 4 for all per-step desync faults is consistent with trial 3's observed {4,6}, but is not proof. Limits: perfect-corpus linear/branch model; no real trie/attention/packer/CUDA-graph/overlap scheduler; fault inputs are hypothetical; F1 root cause remains OPEN and NGRAM stays non-promotable.
